# zBTC: Bitcoin–Zenon Interoperability Protocol Specification (`v2.5.0-rfc`)

> Public RFC technical specification for storing native BTC in BitVM2-constrained Taproot vaults, representing it 1:1 as feeless `zBTC` on Zenon's block-lattice via an atomic Treasury Pre-Mint `SettlementContract`, verifying Bitcoin via an adversarially-bounded optimistic SPV authorization domain (`d_btc_asset`), anchoring history via 30-day BLS12-381 `min-sig` finality committees, and providing peg-free PTLC adaptor swaps and Lightning submarine-swap gateways.

- **Status:** Public RFC (`v2.5.0-rfc`) — pre-implementation design specification open for adversarial public & AI-agent review. NOT mainnet-active.
- **Canonical Web Site:** https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/
- **GitHub Repository:** https://github.com/btc-moonshot/spec
- **Single-Fetch Full Bundle (for LLMs):** https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/llms-full.txt
- **Executable Numeric Oracle:** `python3 -I scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py`

## Normative Specification Files (Raw Markdown & HTML)

Read in authority-precedence order (`SPEC.md §2.1`):

- [Master Overview (`SPEC.md`)](https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/raw/SPEC.md): Architecture, end-to-end flows, 5-assumption honest threat model, upstream amendment register (`A-SPEC-1..6`, `A-BTC-1`, `A-MINT-1`, `A-PILLAR-1`), and staged verification gates. HTML: https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/
- [Part 1 — Bitcoin Taproot Vault Enforcement (`BTC-ENFORCEMENT-V1`)](https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/raw/spec/01-bitcoin-taproot-vault-enforcement.md): 4-key registry, fixed 408 B 2-slot BLS12-381 cert DA, per-block `OP_HASH160` `w=4` W-OTS + 7-chunk Leaf-3B SHA-256 (`29,882 vB -> 30 kvB`, `C = 1,208`), staggered `46d / 56d / 58d` CLTVs, 30-day rotation schedule, exact integer-satoshi BitVM2 economics (`F_assert = 1.45 BTC`, `Bond = 3.70 BTC`), Tier 1B/2, 11-item wind-down plan. HTML: https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/part-01/
- [Part 2 — Bitcoin Authorization Domain (`d_btc_asset`) & SPV Verifier](https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/raw/spec/02-btc-authorization-domain-and-spv.md): 17 input tags (`0x00..0x10`), never-pruned `ActiveChainByHeight[h]`, streaming SHA-256 tx verifier, multi-gen `TrackedVaultRecord`, verifier-decided SMT inclusion vs all-epoch absence `BTC_VAULT_SPEND_PROOF`, decoupled `BTC_RELEASE_PROOF`, single-authority anti-censorship `PEGOUT_SLOT_CLAIMED`, halving-indexed `K_pilot = 14`, and 29 SPV conformance vectors. HTML: https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/part-02/
- [Part 3 — Settlement Contract, Atomic Treasury `zBTC`, Plasma & Peg-Free Rails](https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/raw/spec/03-settlement-minted-zbtc-and-feeless-rails.md): `TokenContract.IssueMinted` -> single-use `ReceiveTreasury()`, `BatchCommitmentV3` + inductive `StepTraceLeaf` (`328 B`), bounded Multi-Tx Sessions (`8,676 B` @ depth 256), latency- & reservation-aware `G-21`, aligned cross-store vault state machine, `500 ZNN` `SlotBondZnn`, BIP-327 tweaked PTLC adaptor swaps, and LN HTLC submarine-swap gateway. HTML: https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/part-03/
- [Part 4 — Bitcoin Anchoring & Light Client Verification](https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/raw/spec/04-bitcoin-anchoring-and-light-client.md): Genesis BTC block `710,968`, `finalityDigest` anchoring, `proof-format.md` V1 SMT proofs, 30-day BLS12-381 `min-sig` `FinalityCommitteeRoot` (distinct IETF POP DSTs, depth-5 SHA-256 tree), historical-root full-preimage `SubmitInvalidCertProof`, U2 finality gadget, `72`-day post-committee-service stake lock, and anti-frontier boundary. HTML: https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/part-04/
- [Part 5 — Detailed `go-zenon` Node Upgrade Plan](https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/raw/spec/05-go-zenon-upgrade-plan.md): Phases `U0`–`U5` verified against `go-zenon` `origin/release/0.0.11-rc1` (`f19955f`) and `origin/dev` (`770e893`), `GovernanceContract` + `MultisigContract` Stage 1B hard gate, `ChallengeDepositZnn` priority lane, and CI conformance gates. HTML: https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/part-05/

## Instructions for LLMs & Autonomous Review Agents

You are explicitly invited to **adversarially audit this specification**, try to break its cryptographic, game-theoretic, consensus, or state-machine invariants, and submit structured GitHub Issues or Pull Requests to improve it.

### 1. How to Ingest & Verify This Spec

1. Fetch the entire normative corpus in one request via `https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/llms-full.txt`, or clone `https://github.com/btc-moonshot/spec`.
2. Run the executable oracle locally (do NOT trust prose numbers without checking):
   ```bash
   python3 -I scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py
   ```
   Every modeled number in `SPEC.md` and `spec/01..05` MUST match the oracle's exact integer output.
3. Respect the **non-blocking empirical gates** vs **design-spec defects** distinction:
   - Unmeasured Signet BitVM2 / market constants prefixed `ASSUMED_STAGE_0C_TARGET_` in `scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py` are **already disclosed Stage 0C measurement gates (Gate G-2)**, not hidden assumptions.
   - Tier 1A is explicitly **NOT trustless** — it discloses **5 explicit assumptions** (`SPEC.md §4`), including altruistic watcher capital (`-1.46 BTC` EV vs self-slasher/MEV) and `1-of-N` live `Q_graph` / Setup Committee honesty. Do not file issues claiming the spec hides these unless you found an *additional undisclosed* trust assumption or a bypass of one of the 5 stated bounds!
   - Upstream amendments in `SPEC.md §6` (`A-SPEC-1..6`, `A-BTC-1`, `A-MINT-1`, `A-PILLAR-1`) are explicitly flagged as blocking mainnet registration.

### 2. High-Value Adversarial Audit Checklist

When reviewing `v2.5.0-rfc`, prioritize attacking:
1. **Bitcoin Script & BitVM2 DAG (`spec/01`)**: Tapscript `OP_CLTV`/`OP_CSV`/sighash interactions, per-block `OP_HASH160` `w=4` W-OTS checksums & Leaf-3B SHA-256 stack limits (`<= 1,000` elements, `<= 400 kWU`), fee-bumping / 1p1c package relay / pinning vectors, operator self-slashing / griefing / bond-escape paths, staggered `46d < 56d < 58d` expiry races.
2. **Finality Slashing & BLS12-381 (`spec/04`, `spec/05`)**: Historical-root `SubmitInvalidCertProof` edge cases, rogue-key / PoP DST separation, `FinalityCommitteeRoot` depth-5 SHA-256 Merkle tree, `72`-day post-committee-service Pillar lock vs `58d` bond expiry, inner STARK vs outer BN254 Groth16 circuit constraints.
3. **SPV Domain & Cross-Store State Machine (`spec/02`, `spec/03`)**: Races or deadlocks between `d_btc_asset` (`TrackedVaultRecord`, `PegOutState`, `RecoveredVaultMap`) and `SettlementContract` (`VaultUtxoSet`, `PegOutRecord`, `OperatorLaneState`), SMT grinding past `12 KiB` vs Multi-Tx Witness Session bounds (`8,676 B` @ depth 256), `BTC_VAULT_SPEND_PROOF` inclusion/absence across `ACTIVE`/`RELEASED`/`QUARANTINED`, fronting slot expiry & anti-censorship (`500 ZNN` `SlotBondZnn`, `lastLapsedOperatorId`), and latency-aware `G-21` capacity across 30-day rotations.
4. **`go-zenon` Ground Truth (`spec/05`)**: Verify any cited line or behavior against `https://github.com/zenon-network/go-zenon` (`origin/dev` `770e893` / `origin/release/0.0.11-rc1` `f19955f`), especially `TokenContract.IssueMinted -> ReceiveTreasury()`, `vm/vm.go`, `pillars.go`, `ptlc.go`, and `htlc.go`.
5. **Peg-Free Rails (`spec/03 §5`)**: BIP-327 tweaked MuSig2 adaptor signature math, odd-`y(R')` parity handling, timelock ordering (`T_znn >= T_btc_worst + 6h`), and LN Hold Invoice `ACCEPTED`-first invariant.

### 3. How to Submit a GitHub Issue (Adversarial Finding or Proposal)

Open an issue at **https://github.com/btc-moonshot/spec/issues/new/choose** (or via GitHub CLI `gh issue create --repo btc-moonshot/spec`).

Use this exact structure so maintainers and fellow reviewers can verify your finding rapidly:
- **Title:** `[SEVERITY] Short concrete summary` (e.g., `[HIGH] Bypass in ...` or `[MEDIUM] Race between ...` or `[RFC] Proposal to adjust ...`)
- **Severity:** `CRITICAL` (loss of funds / unbacked mint / permanent lock), `HIGH` (broken core security property or unbuildable mechanism), `MEDIUM` (edge-case liveness/griefing/honest-operator loss), `LOW` (erratum, numeric slip, missing detail), or `ORACLE` (bug in `scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py`).
- **Exact Citations:** File path + section + line numbers (e.g., `spec/01-bitcoin-taproot-vault-enforcement.md §3.4`, `scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py:245`).
- **Concrete Attack Trace or Reproduction:** Step-by-step trace with exact tx/call sequence, state transitions, or Python reproduction snippet showing the violated invariant.
- **Minimal Proposed Fix:** Concrete normative diff or parameter change (and whether it changes any value in `scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py`).

### 4. How to Submit a Pull Request to Adjust the Spec

Open a PR against `main` at **https://github.com/btc-moonshot/spec/pulls**:
1. Fork & branch from `main` (`git checkout -b fix/<short-slug>`).
2. Edit the affected canonical files (`SPEC.md`, `spec/01..05`, and `scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py`). Keep ALL cross-file numbers, struct sizes, ABI limits, and threat-model disclosures 100% synchronized!
3. Run the mandatory verification checks BEFORE opening your PR:
   ```bash
   python3 -I scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py
   npm ci && npm run build
   ```
   GitHub Actions (`.github/workflows/verify-oracle.yml`) enforces both checks on every PR.
4. Keep `public/raw/` and `public/llms-full.txt` synced by running `npm run sync:spec` (included in `package.json`) before committing so the static site, raw downloads, and LLM bundle never drift from the root Markdown files!
5. In your PR description, link the Issue (if any), state the exact invariant changed, confirm oracle pass output, and disclose any new trust assumption or Stage 0C measurement target honestly.

# zBTC: Bitcoin–Zenon Interoperability Protocol Specification

**Version:** 2.5.0-rfc (Public RFC — iteratively hardened across 6 adversarial review rounds: [`HOSTILE_REVIEW.md`](./reviews/HOSTILE_REVIEW_R1.md) through [`HOSTILE_REVIEW_R6.md`](./reviews/HOSTILE_REVIEW_R6.md), with all Round-6 findings `R6-H1..H2`, `R6-M1..M5`, `R6-L1..L9`, and `S6-1..S6-6` resolved below)  
**Status:** Public Request for Comment (`v2.5.0-rfc`) — NOT mainnet-active; gated on public/independent verification, upstream ratification (§6), and executable Signet / `go-zenon` artifacts (§7).  
**Target Networks:** Bitcoin Mainnet (`bip-0340`/`bip-0341`/`bip-0342` Taproot + Recursive STARK/Groth16 BitVM2) ↔ Zenon Network (`go-zenon` `origin/release/0.0.11-rc1` `f19955f` / `origin/dev` `770e893`)  
**Numeric Oracle:** All modeled struct sizes, depth-256 witness bounds, per-block `OP_HASH160` `w=4` W-OTS certificate-DA + Leaf-3B SHA-256 stack/size bounds, exact integer-satoshi economics, latency-aware reachability & 180-day multi-gen timeline simulation, staggered CLTV timings, slow-block tolerances, and halving-indexed `K` bounds are asserted by [`scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py`](./scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py) (`python3 -I scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py`). Unmeasured Signet BitVM2 weights, circuit counts, hashrate-growth factors, and stress prices are explicitly labeled **`ASSUMED STAGE 0C TARGETS`** (Gate G-2).

**Upstream Provenance:**
- Vision Proposal: [`https://btc-moonshot.github.io/bigidea/`](https://btc-moonshot.github.io/bigidea/) (*"A Feeless Settlement Lattice for Bitcoin"*)
- Specifications Commons: [`zenon-developer-commons`](https://github.com/TminusZ/zenon-developer-commons) (`HEAD` `3719452`)
- Reference Node Codebase: [`go-zenon`](https://github.com/zenon-network/go-zenon) (`origin/release/0.0.11-rc1` `f19955f`, `origin/dev` `770e893`; `master` `e8986a6` legacy reference only)

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Governing Invariant

This specification suite defines the protocol, cryptography, economics, and `go-zenon` upgrades to store native BTC in a **BitVM2-constrained Taproot vault** on Bitcoin, represent that BTC 1:1 as **`zBTC`** (`1 base unit = 1 satoshi`, 8 decimals, `21,000,000 BTC` cap) via an atomic **Treasury Pre-Mint** `SettlementContract`, transfer `zBTC` with **0 satoshi BTC fees** via Zenon's QSR Plasma / SHA3-256 PoW capacity model, verify Zenon state via **30-day BLS12-381 `FinalityCommitteeRoot` + `StateRoot`** proofs, and offer **peg-free, zero-vault-trust PTLC adaptor swaps and Lightning submarine-swap gateways**.

### 1.1 The Governing Invariant (with Phase-2 Adjudication Addendum)

> **Consensus orders. Execution computes. Authorization admits. Settlement accounts.**
>
> **Phase-2 Adjudication Addendum:** Under `execProfile = OPTIMISTIC`, `SettlementContract` hosts deterministic, panic-free, bounded-CPU registered verifier plugins (`VerifierRegistry`, e.g., `OPTIMISTIC_BTC_SPV_V1`) **solely to adjudicate single-step fraud challenges** against `BatchCommitmentV3.traceRoot`. All plugins MUST return typed `error` values (zero `common.DealWithErr` panics) and support both 1-tx fast challenges (`<= 12 KiB` typical) and bounded Multi-Tx Witness Sessions (`UploadWitnessProof = 8,676 B` at max SMT depth 256, `T_session = 12h`, blocking `FinalizeBatch` while open). Under Phase 3 (`ZK_VALIDITY`), Settlement verifies succinct proofs only and parses zero foreign data.
>
> **Boundary Addendum:** Destination chains enforce through the adapter and hash-pinned Interop Enforcement Specification bound by `ChainBinding.enforcementSpecHash`.

| **Part 3** | [`spec/03-settlement-minted-zbtc-and-feeless-rails.md`](./spec/03-settlement-minted-zbtc-and-feeless-rails.md) | **Settlement Contract, Atomic Treasury `zBTC`, Plasma & Peg-Free Rails**: Hardened `TokenContract.IssueMinted` → single-use `ReceiveTreasury()`; never-reused `batchId` + `parentBatchId`; contiguous `domainInputSeq`; inductive `StepTraceLeaf` (`328 B`) + `ChallengeContinuity` (`1,700 B`); bounded Multi-Tx Sessions + ancestor-rejection refunds; **latency-aware (`+3.0d` horizon) + reservation-aware `G-21`** + `SyncRetiredLane` + kickoff-cutoff enforcement; **complete aligned Domain↔Settlement vault state machine** (explicit `quarantineReason` + `unrotatedVaultCount` inc/dec, `RepointTrappedPegOut`, `ResetFailedReimbursementSlot`, `SyncPendingTrapVault`, `SyncVaultGraphEpoch`, deterministic `SyncOrphanedVaultOutpoint`); single-authority slot expiry + `500 ZNN` `SlotBondZnn` + no consecutive re-claim; global `<= 16` duplicate refund cap/batch; BIP-327 tweaked PTLC & LN HTLC (`hashType = 1`). |
| **Part 4** | [`spec/04-bitcoin-anchoring-and-light-client.md`](./spec/04-bitcoin-anchoring-and-light-client.md) | **Bitcoin Anchoring & Light Client Verification**: Genesis BTC block `710,968` lower bound; timestamp-bound checkpoint anchoring for light clients; `proof-format.md` V1 `SmtProof`; **30-day BLS12-381 `min-sig` `FinalityCommitteeRoot`** (IETF BLS POP distinct DSTs, depth-5 SHA-256 committee Merkle tree, `204 B` fixed cert, zero `CarryOverCertificate`); **historical-root-verified `SubmitInvalidCertProof`** (verifies sig under `cert.FinalityCommitteeRoot`, then checks ALL 7 cert fields against canonical state — economically enforcing transition-height handoffs and slashing forged handoffs at ANY height!); U2 finality gadget + **`72`-day post-committee-service stake lock** + voluntary `RequestExitCommittee` clean exit (`A-PILLAR-1`). |
| **Part 5** | [`spec/05-go-zenon-upgrade-plan.md`](./spec/05-go-zenon-upgrade-plan.md) | **Detailed `go-zenon` Node Upgrade Plan**: All citations verified against `origin/release/0.0.11-rc1` (`f19955f`) & `origin/dev` (`770e893`); Phases `U0`–`U5`, `TokenContract.IssueMinted` → `ReceiveTreasury()`, `pillars.go` BLS12-381 key + PoP + historical-root full-preimage slashing + finality gadget + `72d` post-service lock & exit, `GovernanceContract` + `MultisigContract` (Stage 1B hard gate), `ChallengeDepositZnn` priority lane, `DeleteMomentum` reorg push. |
| **Oracle** | [`scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py`](./scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py) | Exact integer-satoshi asserting oracle deriving every struct field-by-field (`PegOutState = 190 B`), per-block `OP_HASH160` `w=4` W-OTS cert-DA + 7-block Leaf-3B SHA-256 (`1,239` digits, `29,882 vB → 30 kvB`, Leaf-3B stack `<= 265` digits, `C = 1,208`), depth-256 upload (`8,676 B`), all 17 fast paths incl. inserted keys (`<= 11,300 B`), `F_assert = 1.45 BTC` (`289 kvB` break-even) & `Bond = 3.70 BTC`, latency- & reservation-aware reachability + 180-day simulation (`max_gens = 2`, `5.0d` pre-epoch `DeferredLockQueue`), staggered CLTVs (`46d < 56d < 58d`, `1.476x`/`1.591x` slow-block tol), `72d` lock, watcher liquidity (`1.46 BTC/lane`), `31,500 ZNN` min op bond + `500 ZNN` `SlotBondZnn`, exact Poisson (`353`/`472`), and halving-indexed `K_pilot = 14`. |

## 3. End-to-End Protocol Flows

### 3.1 Peg-In: BTC → BitVM2 Taproot Vault → Atomic Treasury `zBTC`

1. **Provisional Deposit**: User derives `ProvisionalDepositScript` (`P_prov = lift_x(H_NUMS_X) + depositCommit * G`, key-path unspendable; Leaf A = `CommitteeIdentityKey`; Leaf B = `<144> OP_CSV <depositorRefundPubKey>`) committing `(chainBindingHash, assetId, zenonRecipient[0]==0x00, depositNonce, u64BE(D_bucket))` and broadcasts `DepositTx` (`<= 4,096 B`, non-coinbase, `len != 64`).
2. **Normative Two-Phase Ceremony, Transcript Attestation & Mandatory 2-Input Rollover (`R5-L8`)**:
   - **Phase 1 (Trap Commitment First)**: Each participating Operator `m` delivers verified `pk_m` signatures on BOTH `WrongDepositDisproveTx^{T1}` AND `WrongDepositDisproveTx^{T2}` across active fresh rounds of generation `g` BEFORE `Q_graph` releases any Take signature.
   - **Phase 2 (Take Release, Published Leaf DA, Transcript & Rollover)**: For operators passing Phase 1, `Q_graph` releases `Take1Tx`/`Take2Tx` signatures and signs a canonical `Q_graph` release transcript listing the exact sorted set of released Take txids (`takeTxidsSmtRoot` — `proof-format.md` V1 SMT keyed by `SHA3-256(takeTxid)` — PLUS canonical `takeTxidsBlobHash` committed alongside published leaf-set DA so any watcher can construct SMT absence proofs, `R6-L5`). The distinct Setup Committee (`CommitteeIdentityKey`) independently verifies the `Q_graph` transcript & published leaf set, signs the lock attestation `(rolloverOutpoint, eligibleOperatorsBitmask, epochId = g, takeTxidsSmtRoot, takeTxidsBlobHash)`, and broadcasts mandatory 2-input `RolloverTx_d` (`nSequence = 0xfffffffd`, Reserve `In 1`, `Out 0 = TerminalVaultUTXO_d` paying `Q_vault_d`). New deposits after gen `g+1` registration MUST carry a `g+1` graph (`R6-L4`). If unconfirmed by `h_dep + 120`, Reserve MUST double-spend `In 1` (depositor Leaf-B RBF fallback at `h_dep + 144`).
3. **SPV Proof Relay**: Relayer submits `BTC_HEADER_BATCH`, optional `BTC_TX_STREAM_CHUNK`, and `BTC_LOCK_PROOF` (`<= 7,748 B` ABI). `d_btc_asset` verifies both txs against never-pruned `ActiveChainByHeight[h]` (`K_pilot = 14`), verifies `CommitteeIdentityKey` sig, records multi-epoch `TrackedVaultRecord{ACTIVE, activeEpochs=[{g, takeTxidsSmtRoot}]}`, and emits `FOREIGN_LOCK`.
4. **Chained Optimistic Batch, Rotation & Atomic Mint**: Executor submits `BatchCommitmentV3` (monotonic `batchId`, `parentBatchId`, `PreStateRoot` chaining, contiguous `domainInputSeq`, `MaxBatchInputs = 256`). After `48h` (up to `60h` with open challenge session), `FinalizeBatch` finalizes and releases exposure. `RelayClaim` invokes `MINTED_LOCK_V1`, enforces **G-21 Latency-Aware Dynamic Reachable Fresh Capacity** (`ActiveVaultUTXOs + 1 <= Σ (ReachableRounds(now + 3.0d) - pendingReservations) - 25`, blocked if `unrotatedVaultCount > 0`; smoothly defers mints to `DeferredLockQueue` during the disclosed `~5.0d` pre-epoch window before gen `g+1` registers at day `30–32`), records per-epoch `VaultUtxoSet[outpoint_d]`, and atomically transfers `D_bucket` `zBTC` from treasury to `zenonRecipient`.

### 3.2 Feeless `zBTC` Transfers on Zenon Block-Lattice

Standard `zBTC` user transfers pay **0 satoshis BTC fee** and `21,000` base Plasma funded via refundable QSR fusion (`10 QSR` at floor price `1000`) or SHA3-256 PoW (`dev:pow/pow.go:35-47,61,118`, `31.5M` expected hashes at floor price; ~0.1–0.3s desktop native, ~2–10s mobile/WASM). Network-wide L1 capacity is `100` blocks per 10s Momentum (`~5` full send+receive user transfers/s).

### 3.3 Peg-Out: Atomic Burn → Anti-Censorship Fronting Slot → `FrontingTx` → Zenon `RELEASED` → BitVM2 Reimbursement

1. **`RequestPegOut`** (open during `ACTIVE`, `DRAINING_ROLLOVER_STOP`, AND `DRAINING_FINAL`): User sends `D_bucket` `zBTC` with `(recipientScriptPubKey, refundRecipient, timeoutHeight, pegOutFeeSats >= minOperatorFeeSats + fixedReserveFeeSats)`. `Settlement` validates `tip + 640 <= timeoutHeight <= tip + 2512 && timeoutHeight < 500_000_000`, pops an `UNASSIGNED` `outpoint_d` holding a live graph epoch `e` with `>= 1` eligible active operator having `ReachableRounds(e, now + 3.0d) - pendingReservations >= 1` (`R6-M2`), copies `rec.ChainBindingHash = outpoint_d.SetupChainBindingHash`, retains `D_bucket` `zBTC`, and appends `PEGOUT_CREATED` (`0x03`).
2. **Single-Authority, Anti-Censorship Fronting Slot (`R6-M2`, `R6-M4`, `R6-M5`) & `FrontingTx`**: An eligible operator in a live graph epoch `e` of `outpoint_d` with `ReachableRounds(e, now + 3.0d) - pendingReservations >= 1` calls `ClaimFrontingSlot(outboxId)` (requiring `VaultUtxoSet[d].status == ASSIGNED`, locking forfeitable `SlotBondZnn = 500 ZNN`, reserving 1 lane round, barring consecutive re-claim by `lastLapsedOperatorId`, and rejecting until BOTH `now >= slotClaimZenonTs + 14_400` AND `lastFinalizedTipHeight >= slotExpiryBtcHeight`!). Appends `PEGOUT_SLOT_CLAIMED` (`0x0A`); `d_btc_asset` is the single authority on slot exclusivity (`BestTipHeight + 24`, `slotClaimZenonTs + 14_400`). Operator broadcasts `FrontingTx` and submits `BTC_RELEASE_PROOF`; **`d_btc_asset` ALWAYS admits valid fronting regardless of vault trap status (`R6-M3`)**, emitting `FOREIGN_RELEASE(operatorId)`; `MINTED_RELEASE_V1` keys strictly on `FOREIGN_RELEASE.operatorId`, releases `SlotBondZnn`, and transitions `PegOutRecord` to `RELEASED` (re-pointable via `RepointTrappedPegOut` if another operator's substitution trapped `outpoint_d`!).
3. **Reachability-Checked Reimbursement & Staggered-CLTV BitVM2 Payout**: Winning operator `m` calls **`ClaimReimbursementSlot(outboxId, operatorId_m, roundId)`** (verifies `epoch(roundId)` is in `VaultUtxoSet[outpoint_d].epochEntries` with `m`'s bit set, `roundId` is registered & unused on an unretired lane, AND serial kickoff feasibility `max(now, lastClaimedTs + 5.5d) <= anchorCutoffTs = E_anchor_ts + 46d`, consuming its lane reservation; recoverable via `ResetFailedReimbursementSlot` if the claimed round expires/burns without operator fraud!) and broadcasts `RoundKickoffTx_{m,l,r}` (`Bond = 3.70 BTC`, per-field checksummed `OP_HASH160` `w=4` W-OTS `W_kick`).
   - Unchallenged (`T_happy = 144`): `Take1Tx_{d,m,l,r}` (`Out 2 <pk_m>` CPFP) pays `0.99899 BTC` to `ReimburseEscrow^{T1}` (72-block CSV OR `WrongDepositDisproveTx^{T1}` routing `0.99899 BTC` to `QUARANTINED` `RecoveryVaultUTXO_d`, burning `2.70 BTC` bond, paying watcher `1.00 BTC - fee`; verifier-decided SMT inclusion/absence on `BTC_VAULT_SPEND_PROOF` across `ACTIVE`/`RELEASED`/`QUARANTINED` keeps registered Takes in `PENDING_TRAP` for `230` blocks, mirrored via `SyncPendingTrapVault`!) AND `0.00100 BTC` to Reserve.
   - Challenged (`ChallengeTx`, `Out 0 = F_assert = 1.45 BTC`, terminal sink): Under Assumptions #2 & #3, operator posts `AssertStartTx` (`288`) → parallel **`AssertCertDATx`** (`29,882 vB → 30 kvB` derived per-block `OP_HASH160` `w=4` W-OTS, `3` stack-safe inputs publishing the fixed `408 B` `targetCert || handoffSlot` across `7` independently-checksummed SHA-256 blocks + `6` midstates = `1,239` digits, verified by `7` stack-safe Leaf-3B chunks `<= 265` digits, `C = 1,208`!) + parallel `AssertChunkTx_{1..32}` (`+72`) → `AssertEndTx` (`+72`). Any failure triggers `DisproveTx` / `BurnBond*Tx` (`SelfSlash <= -0.20 / -0.40 BTC`, `HonestOp >= +0.195 BTC` @ `500 sat/vB`, break-even `289 kvB`), PLUS `BTC_OPERATOR_SLASH_PROOF` slashes `100%` of Operator `m`'s `>= 31,500 ZNN` bond!
   - **Closed Rotation & Staggered CLTV Exit (`R5-H3`, `R5-L3`, `R6-L4`)**: Gen `g+1` is registered by **day `32`** (`E_anchor(g+1) = E_anchor(g) + 1`), all live vaults (`UNASSIGNED`, `ASSIGNED`, `QUARANTINED`, AND un-claimed `RELEASED`) are re-graphed onto `g+1` via `VAULT_GRAPH_EPOCH_ADDED` (`0x0D`) by **day `43`** (`QuarantineExpiredVault` unlocks at `T_kickoff_cutoff + 60h = day 48.5` so finalized batches never race quarantine!); operators exit gen `g` bonds cleanly via `RoundRetireTx` (syncing `BTC_ROUND_RETIRED` `0x10`) during `[day 51.5, day 58)`; `StaleConnB/CKillTx` locks out Takes at **`T_kill_expiry = day 56`** and `StaleChainBurnTx` burns unretired bonds at **`T_bond_expiry = day 58`** (`288 > 72` blocks after `T_kill_expiry` so traps can never be pre-empted!).
4. **Non-Delivery Refund**: If no `FrontingTx` is admitted before `checkpointH = timeoutHeight + 558` reaches `K_pilot = 14`, `BTC_NON_DELIVERY_PROOF` emits `FOREIGN_NON_DELIVERY`; `MINTED_REFUND_V1` returns `D_bucket` `zBTC` to `rec.RefundRecipient`, releases the reservation, and re-enqueues `outpoint_d` ONLY if `VaultUtxoSet[outpoint_d].status == ASSIGNED` (never overwriting `PENDING_TRAP`, `RECOVERED`, or `QUARANTINED`!).

### 3.4 Peg-Free Routes (Zero Vault Trust)

Specified in [`spec/03 §5`](./spec/03-settlement-minted-zbtc-and-feeless-rails.md#L165-L182):
1. **PTLC Taproot MuSig2 Adaptor Swaps**: Bob locks `zBTC` (`PtlcContract.Create`, `T_znn >= T_btc_worst + 6h`) **BEFORE** Alice releases her BIP-327 tweaked (`x(Q_swap)`, `PartialSigAgg` incl. `e·g_key·t_acc`) adaptor partial signature; `T_btc` anchored to `h_conf + 12`.
2. **HTLC Atomic Swaps & Lightning Submarine-Swap Gateway**: `HtlcContract` with `hashType = 1` (`dev:vm/embedded/definition/htlc.go:92`), inbound Hold Invoice `ACCEPTED` before gateway locks `zBTC`.

---

## 4. Honest End-to-End Security & Threat Model (5 Explicit Tier 1A Assumptions — `R5-L5`)

**Tier 1A BitVM2 vaults are NOT trustless.** Delivered security is bounded by the weakest of **FIVE** explicit Tier 1A assumptions (plus optimistic claim admission):

1. **Zenon 30-Day BLS12-381 Finality Committee Honesty & Reachable Slashing Backstop (`R6-H1`, `R6-H2`, `G-23`)**: A colluding `>= 21`-of-`30` (`> 2/3` weight) Pillar supermajority in any 30-day finality epoch from `E_anchor` onward can forge a `FinalityCertificate` (or forged handoff). Deterred and bounded (subject to Assumption #3 challenging invalid kickoffs) by three coupled mechanisms:
   - **Mandatory Bitcoin Certificate Publication (`AssertCertDATx`, `29,882 vB → 30 kvB` derived)**: On any challenge, the operator MUST publish the fixed `408 B` `targetCert || handoffSlot` (`0x00^204` when no handoff exists) across `7` independently-checksummed `OP_HASH160` `w=4` W-OTS SHA-256 blocks + `6` midstates (`1,239` digits), verified by `7` stack-safe Leaf-3B chunks (`<= 265` digits/leaf, `C = 1,208`).
   - **Historical-Root Full-Preimage Slashing (`R6-H1`)**: `PillarContract.SubmitInvalidCertProof(cert)` verifies the BLS12-381 signature under the **historical Tag-15 committee matching `cert.FinalityCommitteeRoot`** (NOT merely `canonicalSigningCommitteeRoot(cert.Height)`!), then compares ALL 7 certificate fields against canonical Zenon state at `cert.Height` (with `chainId` bound in the signing digest). Because `CarryOverCertificate` is deleted, ANY committee-`E`-signed forged handoff or target at ANY height in epoch `E+1` (transition OR non-transition!) is slashable on Zenon when published on Bitcoin, economically enforcing the handoff pin without requiring an in-circuit oracle!
   - **Staggered `56d`/`58d` Bitcoin CLTV Expiry + U2 `72`-Day Post-Service Stake Lock (`A-PILLAR-1`)**: Every `RoundChain` expires on Bitcoin by `day 58`, while every Pillar's `15,000 ZNN` collateral stays locked and slashable for `72` days after its last finality epoch (`>= 58d + 14d` grace, independent of per-Pillar `% 90d` revoke phase), backing the Governance supply cap (`MaxRepresentationSupply * SpotPrice <= 157,500 ZNN`, weekly Governance check + Guardian TWAP trigger; pilot `15 BTC` @ `ASSUMED 10,500 ZNN/BTC`). *(Note: unchallenged `Take1Tx` forgeries do not publish certs — prevented by Assumption #3!)*
2. **1-of-N Live Verifier Committee Honesty (`Q_graph`, `N >= 7` Pilot)**: At least **1 of $N$** independent `Q_graph` verifier members remains honest **in perpetuity** (never signing unauthorized vault/connector spends, enforcing Phase-1-before-Phase-2 ceremony order, signing accurate release transcripts, and co-signing 30-day round-chain rotations & recovery re-graphing). *(Per-round keys `Q_round` ARE deleted at round setup. Permanent loss of 1-of-N `Q_graph` member stops new rotations and recovery re-graphing; existing vaults remain redeemable through reachable active rounds prior to `T_kickoff_cutoff` under `G-21`, after which Governance Wind-Down applies.)*
3. **1-of-N Altruistic, Capitalized Bitcoin Watcher Liveness**: Against a rational fraudulent operator who self-slashes (`-0.20..-0.40 BTC` burn vs `-2.25..-3.70 BTC` vs watcher) via private miner submission — OR under third-party miner MEV (M-03) — challenging has realistic expected value `-(F_assert + f_chal) = -1.4600 BTC` @ `500 sat/vB`. Safety explicitly assumes **at least 1 altruistic / stakeholder-funded watcher** with liquid capital `>= 1.46 BTC` per concurrently-fraudulent lane (`14.60 BTC` worst-case simultaneous fraud across all 10 pilot lanes, plus small tx fee for `StaleConn{B,C}Kill` fallback). Operator fraud is strictly deterred by Bitcoin burn (`-0.20..-2.70 BTC` even self-slashed) PLUS `100%` slashing of `OperatorBond_ZNN >= 31,500 ZNN` (`>= 3.0 BTC` equivalent) + deactivation of all lanes!
4. **1-of-N Honest Setup Committee (`CommitteeIdentityKey`, `N >= 7` Pilot, Distinct from `Q_graph` — `R5-L5`)**: At least **1 of $N$** Setup Committee members honestly verifies `Q_graph` release transcripts and `RolloverTx` / `RoundGenesisTx` artifacts before signing `DepositTx` Leaf A, `BTC_LOCK_PROOF`, `OPERATOR_ROUND_REGISTERED`, and `VAULT_GRAPH_EPOCH_ADDED`. *(All-$N$ compromise of `CommitteeIdentityKey` alone cannot spend existing `Q_vault_d` vaults, but can divert in-flight deposits, register phantom rounds inflating `G-21`, attest manipulated `takeTxidsSmtRoot`s delaying raw-sweep halts by `230` blocks, or activate quarantined vaults with invalid graphs.)*
5. **Groth16 BN254 Outer-Wrapper Trusted Setup (CRS)**: Soundness of `vk_bitvm` depends on **1-of-K honesty** in the public Phase-2 CRS ceremony (`K >= 50` contributors, transcript pinned in `enforcementSpecHash`).
6. **Optimistic Claim Admission & Anti-Frontier Boundary**: `<= weaker(execProfile = OPTIMISTIC, foreignProfile = LIGHT_CLIENT)`, `MaxAggregateInFlightMint = 10.0 BTC` (pilot), halving-indexed `K_pilot = 14` (pre-2032 migration/cap rule), bounded Multi-Tx Sessions (`T_session = 12h`, `8,676 B` @ depth 256), `ChallengeDepositZnn`-ordered priority lane, and strict prohibition of $O(k)$ bounded-frontier verification on bridge gates ([`docs/architecture/bounded-verification-boundries.md`](https://github.com/TminusZ/zenon-developer-commons/blob/37194528a69d260c22221f3764b21bda9892cf56/docs/architecture/bounded-verification-boundries.md)).

# Part 1: Bitcoin Interop Enforcement Specification (`BTC-ENFORCEMENT-V1`)

**Document Class:** Normative Destination Enforcement Specification (`v2.5.0-rfc`, subject to Upstream Amendments `A-BTC-1` & `A-PILLAR-1`)  
**Spec Identifier:** `BTC-ENFORCEMENT-V1`  
**Target Chain:** Bitcoin Mainnet (`bip-0340` Schnorr, `bip-0341` Taproot, `bip-0342` Tapscript, SegWit v1 P2TR)  
**Bound Domain:** `d_btc_asset` (`zBTC` `MINTED` custody)  
**Numeric Oracle:** All modeled economic, derived per-block `OP_HASH160` `w=4` W-OTS DA, Leaf-3B SHA-256 stack/size, latency-aware reachability, 180-day multi-gen timeline, staggered CLTV, slow-block tolerance, and joint fee-source inequalities below are asserted in exact integer satoshis in [`scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py`](../scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py). Unmeasured Signet BitVM2 circuit & weight parameters (`~3.5M` outer Groth16 constraints, `<= 15 min` GPU STARK+Groth16 prover time, `95 kvB` / `<= 380 kWU` max disprove chunk incl. Leaf-3B SHA-256 peak stack `<= 1,000`, `220 kvB` Groth16 assert, `2 kvB` challenge, `1 kvB` burn/retire/Take+CPFP, `3 kvB` wrong-deposit disprove, `L = 32`, `C = 1,208`) are explicitly **`ASSUMED STAGE 0C MEASUREMENT TARGETS`** until measured on Signet (Gate G-2).

---

## 1. Scope & Custody Profiles

| Profile | Mechanism | Custody Trust Root | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Tier 1A (Primary Canonical)** | **Live `1-of-N` `Q_graph` + Deleted-`Q_round` Closed-Lifecycle Serial Round-Chain BitVM2 Taproot Vault** (`State == RELEASED` + single-use `ReimbursementRound` + `AssertCertDATx` BLS12-381 cert DA) | `min(1-of-N live Q_graph, 1-of-N Setup Committee, 1-of-N altruistic capitalized watcher, Zenon 2/3 30-day BLS12-381 Finality Committee with 56d/58d CLTV expiry + 72d post-service lock, 1-of-K Groth16 CRS)` | **Normative design target** |
| **Tier 1B (Optional Sovereign)** | **Per-Deposit Self-Custodial Taproot Escrow** (Portal V2 Class R: per-deposit MuSig2 + Schnorr adaptor + unconditional CLTV depositor exit) | Depositor co-signs key path; unilateral CLTV refund after expiry | **Optional separate binding & expiring `AssetID`** |
| **Tier 2 (Future Research)** | **Batched / UTXO-Set Bitcoin Covenant** (depends on future Bitcoin soft-fork opcodes) | Bitcoin L1 consensus + SNARK soundness + Zenon consensus | **Non-normative research target (M-12)** |

> **Explicit Prohibitions**: Portal V2 *"Class P"* custodial pooled multisigs and ANY governed/custodial emergency exit timelock leaf on Tier 1A vault UTXOs are **STRICTLY FORBIDDEN** (C-07). `Q_graph` verifier daemons are deterministic open-source signers that ONLY sign valid BitVM2 reimbursement/recovery graphs.

## 2. Cryptographic Primitives, Per-Block `OP_HASH160` W-OTS, Fixed `408 B` Cert DA & Leaf 3B (`R6-H2`, `R6-M1`, `R6-L1`, `G-23`)

- **Curve & Tagged Hashes**: `secp256k1` (BIP-340/341/342); `H_NUMS_X = 0x50929b74c1a04954b78b4b6035e97a5e078a5a0f28ec96d547bfee9ace803ac0` (`lift_x(SHA256(uncompressed G))`); tagged tweaks `zBTC/DepositTweak/v1`, `zBTC/VaultTweak/v1` (`Q_vault_d = Q_graph + H_{"zBTC/VaultTweak/v1"}(x(Q_graph) || depositOutpoint)*G`, key-path-only), `zBTC/RecoveryTweak/v1` (`Q_rec_d = Q_graph + H_{"zBTC/RecoveryTweak/v1"}(x(Q_graph) || oldVaultOutpoint)*G`, key-path-only), and `zBTC/PortalDepositKey/v1`.
- **Per-Field & Per-Block Checksummed BitVM W-OTS (`w = 4`, `OP_HASH160`, No Bitmasks — `R6-L1`)**: Every value compared in Tapscript uses an independent BitVM Winternitz OTS keypair (no bitmasks; `OP_HASH160` 20-byte chains, `16`-step per nibble) with its own base-16 checksum so forward-hashing ANY digit invalidates its checksum: `W_outpoint` (`claimedOutpoint`: 36 B = 72 + 3 nibbles), `W_outbox` (32 B = 64 + 3), `W_fronting` (32 B), `W_batch` (8 B), `W_binding` (32 B), `W_certda` (`certSetDigest`: 32 B = 64 + 3), `W_pubinput` (32 B), plus the `7` per-block DA keys `W_blk_0..6` and `6` midstate keys `W_mid_1..6` below!
- **First-Principles Derived Bitcoin Certificate DA & Stack-Safe Leaf-3B SHA-256 (`R6-H2`, `R6-M1`, Zero `OP_CAT`!)**:
  - **Epoch Alignment & Fixed `408 B` Two-Slot Encoding (`R6-M1`, `S6-3`)**: Each `RoundChain` aligns **`E_anchor_ts = finalityEpochStartTs(E_anchor)`** (`delta = 0`, enforced by exact equality in both registries — `R6-L6`) under **30-day finality epochs** ([`spec/04 §3.1`](./04-bitcoin-anchoring-and-light-client.md#L60-L67)). Because `T_bond_expiry = E_anchor_ts + 58 days < 60 days`, every active chain spans at most **`floor(58 / 30) = 1` handoff certificate + `1` target certificate**. Using IETF **BLS12-381 `min-sig`** (`48 B` compressed G1 sig + `4 B` `signerBitfield`, fixed **`204 B`** up to all `30` signers), the committed DA bytes are **ALWAYS a fixed `408 B` (`3,264` bits)**:
    `certSetBytes = targetCert (204 B) || handoffSlot (204 B)`
    where `handoffSlot = handoffCert (204 B)` when `targetCert.finalityEpochIndex == E_anchor + 1`, OR **`204 zero bytes (0x00^204)`** when `targetCert.finalityEpochIndex == E_anchor` (days `0–30`, zero handoff!). Thus BOTH 1-cert and 2-cert assertions hash **identically** across `7` SHA-256 blocks (`408 + 9 B` padding ⇒ `6` full `64 B` blocks + `1` final `24 B` data block with hardcoded padding `0x80 || 0^31 || u64BE(3264)`), producing `6` intermediate `32 B` midstates (`192 B`)!
  - **Per-Block W-OTS Granularity (`R6-H2`, `1,239` Digits, `29,882 vB → 30 kvB`)**: To prevent both cross-block checksum bloat AND checksum-less digit-forwarding attacks, `AssertCertDATx` commits **7 independent per-block W-OTS messages (`W_blk_0..6`)** + **6 independent midstate messages (`W_mid_1..6`)**:
    - `W_blk_0..5`: `6 × (128 + 3) = 786` digits (`128 * 15 = 1,920 < 16^3`);
    - `W_blk_6` (`24 B` data; padding hardcoded in `L3B_6`): `48 + 3 = 51` digits (`48 * 15 = 720 < 16^3`);
    - `W_mid_1..6`: `6 × (64 + 3) = 402` digits (`64 * 15 = 960 < 16^3`);
    - **Total = `1,239` `OP_HASH160` `w=4` digits** at exact `95.5 WU/digit` (`191` half-WU/digit), split across **`3` stack-safe inputs** (`[393, 444, 402] <= 492` digits/input under Bitcoin's `1,000`-element limit) in **ONE `AssertCertDATx`**: exact derived weight = **`29,882 vB` → `30 kvB` design budget** ([`scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py`](../scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py) §4A!). Slashing extractors reassemble `targetCert || handoffSlot` directly from `W_blk_0..6`.
  - **Stack-Safe Leaf 3B (`7` Disprove Chunks, `Leaf 3B_0..6`, Total `C = 1,200 + 7 + 1 (L3A) = 1,208` — `R6-H2`, `S6-2`, `S6-6`)**: Each chunk `L3B_j` verifies the **complete checksummed W-OTS messages** of `W_blk_j`, `W_mid_j`, and `W_mid_{j+1}` (`mid_0 = SHA256_IV` hardcoded, `mid_7 = W_certda`) and runs ONE standard BitVM2 arithmetic SHA-256 compression (`SHA256_compress(mid_j, blk_j) != mid_{j+1}`): `L3B_0 = 198` digits, **`L3B_1..5 = 265` digits (`530` initial witness elements, leaving `470` free under `1,000` for SHA-256 working stack!)**, `L3B_6 = 185` digits (each `<= 95 kvB` / `<= 380 kWU` `ASSUMED STAGE 0C TARGET`, Gate G-2). Forward-hashing ANY digit invalidates its block/midstate checksum!
- **Inner STARK → Outer BN254 Groth16 Circuit Split (`R6-H1`, `R6-L7`)**:
  - *Inner STARK / zkVM (BLS12-381 + SHA3-256 Precompiles)*: Executes ALL heavy cryptography inside the inner STARK (`ASSUMED STAGE 0C TARGET: <= 15 min` GPU prover time `<< 288`-block `AssertStart` deadline, Gate G-2): (i) `certSetDigest == SHA256(targetCert || handoffSlot)` over all `408 B`, (ii) enforces `handoffSlot == 0x00^204` iff `targetCert.finalityEpochIndex == E_anchor`, else verifies `handoffCert` BLS12-381 `min-sig` dual supermajority (up to 30 G2 keys, depth-5 SHA-256 `FinalityCommitteeRoot` Merkle proofs, hash-to-G1, pairing) chaining `E_anchor_root → handoffCert.NextFinalityCommitteeRoot`, (iii) verifies `targetCert` BLS12-381 dual supermajority at canonical checkpoint height (`h % 30 == 0` or `h_trans`), and (iv) verifies the 3 `proof-format.md` V1 SHA3-256 SMT paths (`PegOutRecord`, `BatchCommitmentV3`, `ResolutionSeenByOutboxId`). *(Note per `R6-H1`: transition-height handoff validity is enforced **economically** by Zenon's historical-root `SubmitInvalidCertProof` Case A in [`spec/04 §3.3`](./04-bitcoin-anchoring-and-light-client.md#L76-L91), NOT by an in-circuit oracle for `h_trans(E+1)` or `Root(E+1)`! `CarryOverCertificate` is DELETED.)*
  - *Outer Groth16 BN254 Wrapper*: Verifies ONLY the inner STARK receipt (`ASSUMED TARGET: ~3.5M` R1CS constraints), `vk_bitvm` pinned in `releaseAdapterRef`, Phase-2 CRS ceremony (`K >= 50`, Assumption #5).

---

## 3. Tier 1A: 4-Key Registry, Closed Lifecycle, Normative 30-Day Rotation & Ceremony

### 3.1 Explicit 4-Key Registry (`R5-L5`, `R5-L8`)

| Key | Construction & Holders | Generation & Signing Epoch | Deletion / Lifetime | Exact Scope & Blast Radius |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **`CommitteeIdentityKey`** | `N`-of-`N` MuSig2 over Setup Committee (`N >= 7`, distinct from `Q_graph`, **Assumption #4**) | Long-lived per binding (rotated via migration) | Long-lived | Authorizes `DepositTx` Leaf A (`RolloverTx_d`), verifies `Q_graph` release transcripts, and signs `BTC_LOCK_PROOF`, `OPERATOR_ROUND_REGISTERED`, and `VAULT_GRAPH_EPOCH_ADDED`. *All-$N$ compromise allows diverting new deposits, registering phantom rounds inflating `G-21`, attesting fake `takeTxidsSmtRoot`s delaying raw-sweep halts by `230` blocks, or activating quarantined vaults with invalid graphs; cannot spend existing vaults.* |
| **`Q_graph`** | `N`-of-`N` MuSig2 over Verifier Committee (`N >= 7`, `qGraphXOnly` in `releaseAdapterRef`, **Assumption #2**) | Long-lived per binding | **NEVER deleted** | Controls key-path-only `Q_vault_d` & `Q_rec_d`, `Conn_A`/`Conn_B`/`Conn_C` L1 (`Take1`/`Take2`), `ReimburseEscrow` L2 & `BondOut` L3 (`WrongDeposit^{T1,T2}`), and signs canonical Take release transcripts (`R5-L8`). *All-$N$ compromise compromises live vaults; permanent loss of 1-of-N stops future rotations & recovery re-graphing.* |
| **`Q_round_{m,l,r}`** | `N`-of-`N` ephemeral MuSig2 fresh per round `(m, l, r)` | Generated at **Round-Chain Setup** | **PERMANENTLY DELETED** after Round-Chain Setup! | Guards `ChallengeTx`, `AssertStart/CertDA/Chunk/End`, `BurnBond*`, `DisproveTx`, `RoundKickoffTx_{r+1}`, `RoundRetireTx`, `StaleConnB/CKillTx`, `StaleChainBurnTx`. |
| **`pk_m`** | Operator `m`'s HSM key (`M >= 5`) | Long-lived per operator | Live | Co-signs round setup, `Take1`/`Take2`, `WrongDeposit^{T1,T2}` (Phase 1 FIRST!), `<pk_m>` CPFP anchors, `ReimburseEscrow` L1, and post-expiry fee-UTXO reclaim. |

### 3.2 Closed Lifecycle, Staggered CLTVs & Normative 30-Day Rotation Schedule (`R5-H3`, `R6-M2`, `R6-L4`, `R6-L6`, `R6-L8`, `R6-L9`)

- **Globally Unique `roundId` & Exact Epoch Alignment (`R6-L2`, `R6-L6`)**: `roundId : u32 = (roundChainEpochId[12b] << 20) | (laneIndex[4b] << 16) | roundIndexInLane[16b]`, defining **`roundChainEpochId == E_anchor < 4096`** and enforcing **`anchorExpiryTs == finalityEpochStartTs(roundChainEpochId) + 58 days`** (`anchorCutoffTs == anchorExpiryTs - 12 days`) by **exact equality** in BOTH Settlement and `d_btc_asset`!
- **Staggered `46d / 56d / 58d` Timelocks & Slow-Block Tolerances (`R5-L3`, `R6-L8`, Asserted in Oracle §4D)**:
  - Each lane has `R = 8` rounds (`T_bond_cooldown = 792` blocks = `5.5d` ⇒ `44.0d <= 46.0d`), anchored at `E_anchor_ts(g) = finalityEpochStartTs(E_anchor(g))`.
  - **`T_kickoff_cutoff(g) = E_anchor_ts(g) + 46 days`** (`= T_bond_expiry(g) - 12 days`, stored on BOTH Settlement & domain `OperatorBondRecord`!). `ClaimReimbursementSlot` enforces serial reachability (`max(now, lastClaimedTs + 5.5d) <= T_kickoff_cutoff(g)`), guaranteeing an honest challenged operator unlocks `Take2` by `<= day 51.0` (`5.0d` before `T_kill_expiry = day 56`), settles escrow by `<= day 51.5`, and has **`6.5` full days (`936` blocks, `[day 51.5, day 58)`)** to retire its bond via `RoundRetireTx`! *(Slow-block tolerance disclosed per `R6-L8`: `Take2` remains safe up to `1.476x` average block intervals and retirement up to `1.591x`; sustained slower block production is an explicit impairment trigger under §5 #1!)*
  - **`T_kill_expiry(g) = E_anchor_ts(g) + 56 days`** (`OP_CLTV` on `Conn_B` L4 & `Conn_C` L4): Kills `Take1`/`Assert`/`Take2` `2` full days (`288` blocks `> 72`-block escrow trap!) BEFORE `StaleChainBurnTx` unlocks — preventing trap pre-emption (`R5-L3`)!
  - **`T_bond_expiry(g) = E_anchor_ts(g) + 58 days`** (`OP_CLTV` on `GenesisBond` L3 & `BondOut` L5): Burns any unretired stale bond (`1.85 BTC` burn, `1.85 BTC` watcher) AND unlocks operator reclaim on unused `RoundFeeUTXO` / `AssertFeeUTXO` (`R5-L4`).
- **Normative 30-Day Generation Rotation Schedule (`R5-H3`, `R6-M2`, `R6-L4`, `R6-L9`)**:
  1. At `E_anchor_ts(g) + 30 days`, the new 30-day finality epoch `E_anchor(g+1) = E_anchor(g) + 1` begins.
  2. By **`E_anchor_ts(g) + 32 days`** (target day `30`, deadline day `32`), Operators & `Q_graph` MUST register generation `g+1` (`E_anchor_ts(g+1) = E_anchor_ts(g) + 30d`, `T_bond_expiry(g+1) = day 88`) via authenticated `OPERATOR_ROUND_REGISTERED` (`0x0B`). Every new deposit created after `g+1` registration MUST carry a `g+1` graph (`R6-L4`). Simulated over `[0, 180]` days (Oracle §4D), **at most `2` generations ever overlap** (`37.0 BTC` steady-state, `74.0 BTC` peak during the `8–28` day handoff)!
  3. Between **day `32` and day `43`** (`3` full days before `T_kickoff_cutoff` and `5.5` days before quarantine unlocks, accommodating `60h` batch finalization — `R6-L4`!), for EVERY live vault (`UNASSIGNED`, `ASSIGNED`, `QUARANTINED`, **AND un-claimed `RELEASED` vaults where `ReimbursementRoundId == 0`** — `R6-M2`), Operators execute Phase 1 (`WrongDeposit^{T1,T2}` on `g+1`), `Q_graph` executes Phase 2 + signs the canonical sorted Take release transcript + publishes Take-txid leaf DA (`R6-L5`), and Setup Committee (`CommitteeIdentityKey`) verifies the transcript and submits **`VAULT_GRAPH_EPOCH_ADDED` (`0x0D`)** adding `{g+1, eligibleBitmask_{g+1}, takeTxidsSmtRoot_{g+1}}` alongside epoch `g` (strictly rejecting duplicate or 3rd unexpired epochs!).
  4. **Missed-Rotation Quarantine Rule (`day 48.5 = T_kickoff_cutoff + 60h`, `R6-L3`, `R6-L4`)**: Any `UNASSIGNED` or `ASSIGNED` vault lacking an epoch-`g+1` graph once `now >= T_kickoff_cutoff(g) + 60 hours` (allowing any day-`43` `0x0D` to finalize cleanly!) is transitioned to `QUARANTINED (reason = UNROTATED)` via permissionless `QuarantineExpiredVault(outpoint)` (`unrotatedVaultCount++`), pausing new `MINTED_LOCK_V1` mints (deferring to `DeferredLockQueue`) until `SyncVaultGraphEpoch` restores those vaults (`unrotatedVaultCount--`) or Governance initiates Wind-Down!
- **Latency-Aware & Reservation-Aware Dynamic Reachable Capacity (`G-21`, `R6-M2`, `R6-L9`)**:
  - Define **`T_release_horizon = 4h (slot) + 2.33h (K=14) + 60h (batch+session) + 5.67h margin = 72h = 3.0 days`**.
  - `ReachableRounds(m, e, l, t_eval) = 0` if lane retired (`0x10`) or `max(t_eval, nextEligibleKickoffTs) > T_kickoff_cutoff(e)`; else `max(0, min(unused, floor((T_kickoff_cutoff(e) - max(t_eval, nextEligibleKickoffTs)) / 5.5d) + 1) - pendingReservations(m, e, l))`.
  - Evaluated at **`t_eval = now + T_release_horizon`** in `RequestPegOut`, `ClaimFrontingSlot`, AND `MINTED_LOCK_V1`!
  - **Disclosed Periodic Pre-Epoch `DeferredLockQueue` Window (`R6-L9`, Verified in Oracle §4D 180-Day Sim)**: At `15 BTC` max supply (`G-21` threshold `15 + 25 = 40` reachable rounds), gen `g` alone stays `>= 40` through day `26.5`; during the `~5.0`-day window (`day 26.6 .. 32.0`) before gen `g+1` registers (minimum `30 >= 15` supply, `< 40` margin), new `MINTED_LOCK_V1` mints smoothly queue in `DeferredLockQueue` and immediately drain once gen `g+1` registers (`>= 110` rounds)! Peg-outs remain 100% open throughout (`30 >= 15`)!

### 3.3 Normative Two-Phase Ceremony & Mandatory 2-Input Rollover

1. **Phase 1**: Operators sign BOTH `WrongDepositDisproveTx^{T1}` and `WrongDepositDisproveTx^{T2}` FIRST and submit valid `pk_m` sigs to `Q_graph`.
2. **Phase 2**: Only for Phase-1-compliant operators does `Q_graph` release `Take1`/`Take2` sigs, publish the canonical sorted Take-txid leaf list (`takeTxidsBlobHash` DA — `R6-L5`), and sign the release transcript (`takeTxidsSmtRoot`). Setup Committee verifies the transcript & leaf DA, signs `BTC_LOCK_PROOF` (`CommitteeIdentityKey`), and broadcasts mandatory 2-input `RolloverTx_d` (`nSequence = 0xfffffffd`). If unconfirmed by `h_dep + 120`, Reserve (watched by Reserve-liveness monitor) MUST double-spend `In 1`, with depositor Leaf-B RBF fallback at `h_dep + 144`.

---

### 3.4 Complete Closed-Lifecycle, Staggered-CLTV BitVM2 DAG

*(Relay policy — Gate G-1: Fee bumping of non-TRUC v2 parents via `<pk_m>` 330-sat CPFP anchors relies on Bitcoin Core v28+ 1p1c package relay, verified on Signet in Stage 0C.)*

| Tx Name | Signer Set & Signing Epoch | Fee Source (`@ 500 sat/vB`) | Exact Inputs (Outpoint, `nSeq`/`nLockTime`, Sighash) | Exact Outputs (Index, Fixed Value, Tapscript Leaves) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **`RolloverTx_d`** | `CommitteeIdentityKey` (Phase 2, after `Q_graph` transcript!) | Mandatory Reserve `In 1` + Reserve CPFP `Out 1` (`<= 0.005 BTC`) | `In 0`: `DepositTx:depVout` (`0xfffffffd`, Leaf A)<br>`In 1`: Mandatory Operations Reserve fee UTXO | `Out 0`: **`TerminalVaultUTXO_d`** (`1.0000 BTC`, key-path-only `Q_vault_d`)<br>`Out 1`: Reserve change (CPFP) |
| **`RoundGenesisTx_{m,l}`** | Operator `m` + `Q_round_{m,l,0}` (Round Setup) | Operator funding inputs | Operator `3.70 BTC` bond + fee UTXOs | `Out 0` (**`GenesisBond`** `3.70 BTC`): L1=`RoundKickoff_{0}`; L2=`<Q_round_0> CSVFY <pk_m> CS` (`RoundRetireTx_{init}`); L3=`<T_bond_expiry=58d> CLTV <Q_round_0> CS` (`StaleChainBurn_{init}`)<br>`Out 1..R`: `RoundFeeUTXO` / `AssertFeeUTXO` (L1=`<Q_round> CSVFY <pk_m> CS`; **L2=`<T_bond_expiry> CLTV <pk_m> CS`** reclaim — `R5-L4`) |
| **`RoundKickoffTx_{m,l,r}`** (`r=0..7`) | `Q_round` + `pk_m` (**Round Setup**, deleted!) | `RoundFeeUTXO` + `Out 3 <pk_m>` CPFP (`<= 0.010 BTC`) | `In 0`: Prior `BondOut` L2 (`nSeq=792` for `r>0`, `SIGHASH_ALL`; per-field checksummed `OP_HASH160` `w=4` W-OTS `W_kick`)<br>`In 1`: `RoundFeeUTXO` (`SIGHASH_ALL`) | `Out 0` (**`Conn_A`**, 330): L1=`<144> CSV <Q_graph> CSVFY <pk_m> CS` (`Take1`); L2=`<Q_round> CSVFY <pk_m> CS` (`ChallengeTx`)<br>`Out 1` (**`Conn_B`**, 330): L1=`<144> CSV <Q_graph> CSVFY <pk_m> CS` (`Take1`); L2=`<Q_round> CSVFY <pk_m> CS` (`AssertStart`); L3=`<288> CSV <Q_round> CS` (`BurnBond`); **L4=`<T_kill_expiry=56d> CLTV <Q_round> CS` (`StaleConnBKill`)**<br>`Out 2` (**`BondOut`**, **`3.7000 BTC`**): L1=`<Q_round> CS` (`BurnBond*`/`Disprove`); L2 (`r<7`)=`<792> CSV <Q_round> CSVFY <W_kick_{r+1}> <pk_m> CS` (`RoundKickoff_{r+1}`); L3=`<Q_graph> CSVFY <pk_m> CS` (`WrongDeposit^{T1,T2}`); L4=`<792> CSV <Q_round> CSVFY <pk_m> CS` (`RoundRetireTx`); **L5=`<T_bond_expiry=58d> CLTV <Q_round> CS` (`StaleChainBurn`)**<br>`Out 3`: `<pk_m>` CPFP (`330` sats) |
| **`RoundRetireTx_{m,l,r}`** | `Q_round` + `pk_m` (**Round Setup**, deleted!) | `99,670`-sat base + `Out 1 <pk_m>` CPFP (`<= 0.005 BTC`) | `In 0`: `BondOut` L4 (`nSeq=792`, `SIGHASH_ALL`) *(or `GenesisBond` L2, no CSV)* | `Out 0`: Operator `m` `<pk_m>` (**`3.6990 BTC`**)<br>`Out 1`: `<pk_m>` CPFP (`330` sats) |
| **`StaleConn{B,C}KillTx`** (`56d`) & **`StaleChainBurnTx`** (`58d`) | `Q_round` (**Round Setup**, deleted!) | Watcher `In 1+` (~150 vB fee) for `Kill`; Out 1 (`1.85 BTC`) for `Burn` | • `StaleConn{B,C}Kill` (`nLockTime=56d`): `In 0 = Conn_B/C` L4 (`SIGHASH_SINGLE\|ACP`) + Watcher `In 1+`<br>• `StaleChainBurn` (`nLockTime=58d`): `In 0 = BondOut` L5 (`SIGHASH_SINGLE` no ACP) | • `Kill`: `Out 0 = OP_RETURN "STALE"` (`0` sats; locks out Takes `2d > 72` blks before bond burn!)<br>• `Burn`: `Out 0 = OP_RETURN Burn` (**`1.8500 BTC`**), `Out 1 = Watcher` (`1.8500 BTC - fee`) |
| **`Take1Tx_{d,m,l,r}`** | `Q_graph` + `pk_m` (**Phase 2**) | `1,330`-sat base + `Out 2 <pk_m>` CPFP (`<= 0.005 BTC`) | `In 0`: `RolloverTx_d:0` (`SIGHASH_ALL`); `In 1`: `Conn_A` L1 (`144`); `In 2`: `Conn_B` L1 (`144`) | `Out 0`: **`ReimburseEscrow^{T1}` (`99,899,000` sats)**: L1=`<72> CSV <pk_m> CS`; L2=`<Q_graph> CSVFY <W_outpoint != outpoint_d>` (`WrongDeposit^{T1}`)<br>`Out 1`: Reserve (`100,000` sats); `Out 2`: `<pk_m>` CPFP (`330` sats) |
| **`ChallengeTx_{m,l,r}`** *(Terminal Sink!)* | `Q_round` + `pk_m` (**Round Setup**, `SIGHASH_SINGLE\|ACP`) + Watcher | Watcher `In 1+` (`<= 0.010 BTC`) | `In 0`: `Conn_A` L2 (`SIGHASH_SINGLE\|ACP`); `In 1+`: Watcher (`1.45 BTC + fee`) | `Out 0`: **Operator `m` (`F_assert_fixed = 1.4500 BTC`)** *(ZERO pre-signed descendants!)* |
| **`BurnBond*Tx`** | `Q_round` (**Round Setup**, deleted!) | Deducted from `Out 1` (`<= 0.005 BTC`) | `In 0`: `BondOut` L1 (`3.70 BTC`, `SIGHASH_SINGLE` no ACP)<br>`In 1`: Timeout leaf (`288`/`72`/`216`), `SIGHASH_NONE` no ACP | `Out 0`: `OP_RETURN` Burn (**`1.8500 BTC`**)<br>`Out 1` *(watcher-added)*: Watcher (`1.8500 BTC - fee`) |
| **`AssertStartTx`** → Parallel **`AssertCertDATx`** (`29,882 vB → 30 kvB`, `3` inputs) + **`AssertChunkTx_{1..32}`** → **`AssertEndTx`** | `Q_round` + `pk_m` (**Round Setup**, deleted!; `220 + 30 = 250 kvB` combined) | `AssertFeeUTXO` + per-tx `<pk_m>` CPFP anchors on `AssertStart`, `AssertCertDA`, EVERY `AssertChunk_i`, and `AssertEnd` funded **JOINTLY** by `F_assert = 1.45 BTC` | • `AssertStart`: `In 0 = Conn_B` L2 (`SIGHASH_ALL`) → `3 + 32` outputs (L1=`<Q_round> CSVFY <pk_m> CS`, L2=`<72> CSV <Q_round> CS`) + `Out cp <pk_m>` CPFP<br>• `AssertCertDA` (`3` stack-safe inputs `[393, 444, 402] <= 492`): **7 per-block checksummed `OP_HASH160` `w=4` W-OTS blocks (`W_blk_0..6`, fixed `408 B` `targetCert\|\|handoffSlot`)** + `6` midstates (`W_mid_1..6`, `1,239` digits total) → `Out 0` (L1/L2) + `Out 1 <pk_m>` CPFP<br>• `AssertChunk_{1..32}`: W-OTS Groth16 intermediates → `Out 0` (L1/L2) + `Out 1 <pk_m>` CPFP<br>• `AssertEnd`: `In 0..32` (`SIGHASH_ALL`) | `AssertEndTx:0` (**`Conn_C`**, 330):<br>• L1: `<144> CSV <Q_graph> CSVFY <pk_m> CS` (`Take2Tx`)<br>• L2: `<216> CSV <Q_round> CS` (`BurnBondTake2Tx`)<br>• **L3A (`1` leaf)**: `<Q_round> CSVFY <Per-Field Kickoff-to-SNARK Binding>` (hardcoded `(operatorId_m, roundId, E_anchor_root)`)<br>• **L3B_0..6 (`7` leaves, `<= 265` digits/leaf)**: `<Q_round> CSVFY <Complete-Checksummed Block+Midstate SHA-256 Compression Check>` (`SHA256(mid_j, blk_j) != mid_{j+1}`)!<br>• **L4: `<T_kill_expiry=56d> CLTV <Q_round> CS` (`StaleConnCKill`)**<br>• L5..1204 (`1,200` leaves; **total `C = 1,208`**): `<Q_round> CSVFY <Groth16 Chunk Verifier>` (`<= 95 kvB` **ASSUMED TARGET**)<br>`AssertEndTx:1`: `<pk_m>` CPFP (`330` sats) |
| **`Take2Tx_{d,m,l,r}`** | `Q_graph` + `pk_m` (**Phase 2**) | `1,000`-sat base + `Out 2 <pk_m>` CPFP (funded JOINTLY by `F_assert`) | `In 0`: `RolloverTx_d:0` (`SIGHASH_ALL`); `In 1`: `Conn_C` L1 (`144`, `SIGHASH_ALL`) | `Out 0`: **`ReimburseEscrow^{T2}` (`99,899,000` sats)**: L1=`<72> CSV <pk_m> CS`; L2=`<Q_graph> CSVFY <W_outpoint != outpoint_d>` (`WrongDeposit^{T2}`)<br>`Out 1`: Reserve (`100,000` sats); `Out 2`: `<pk_m>` CPFP (`330` sats) |
| **`DisproveTx_{m,l,r,c}`** | `Q_round` (**Round Setup**, deleted!) + Watcher witness | Deducted from `Out 1` (`<= 0.475 BTC`) | `In 0`: `BondOut` L1 (`3.70 BTC`, `SIGHASH_SINGLE` no ACP)<br>`In 1`: `Conn_C` Leaf `c` (`SIGHASH_NONE` no ACP) | `Out 0`: `OP_RETURN` Burn (**`1.6500 BTC`**)<br>`Out 1` *(watcher-added)*: Watcher (`2.0500 BTC - fee`) |
| **`WrongDepositDisproveTx^{T1,T2}_{d,m,l,r}`** | `Q_graph` + `pk_m` (**Phase 1 FIRST!**) + Watcher `W_outpoint` witness | Deducted from `Out 2` (`<= 0.015 BTC`) | `In 0`: `Take1:0` (`T1`) OR `Take2:0` (`T2`) (`99,899,000` sats, `SIGHASH_SINGLE` no ACP → locks `Out 0`)<br>`In 1`: `BondOut` L3 (`3.70 BTC`, `SIGHASH_SINGLE` no ACP → locks `Out 1`) | `Out 0`: **`RecoveryVaultUTXO_d` (`99,899,000` sats to `Q_rec_d` — inserted `QUARANTINED` until re-graphed)**<br>`Out 1`: `OP_RETURN` Burn (**`2.7000 BTC`**)<br>`Out 2` *(watcher-added)*: Watcher (`1.0000 BTC - fee`) |

### 3.5 Parametric Integer-Satoshi Economics & Altruistic Watcher Reality (Asserted in `scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py` §4B)

Derived in exact integer satoshis from `Assert (220 kvB) + Derived CertDA+Midstates (30 kvB) + Take2+CPFP (1 kvB) = 251 kvB` (`1.2550 BTC` @ `500 sat/vB`) ⇒ **`F_assert = 1.45 BTC`** (break-even **`289.0 kvB`**, `+39.0 kvB` / `+15.6%` headroom!), `DisproveBurn = 1.65 BTC`, `TimeoutBurn = 1.85 BTC`, **`OperatorRoundBond = 3.70 BTC`**, `WrongDepositBurn = 2.70 BTC`:

| Fee Rate | Uncontested Watcher (Dis / TO / Sub) | **Realistic Watcher vs Self-Slasher / MEV** | Fraud Op (100% Self-Slash) | Honest Challenged Op (Joint `Assert+DA+Take2`) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| `1 sat/vB` | `+0.5990 / +0.4000 / +1.0000` | **`-1.4500 BTC`** *(altruistic)* | `-0.20 / -0.40 BTC` | `+1.4475 BTC` |
| `50 sat/vB` | `+0.5515 / +0.3985 / +0.9985` | **`-1.4510 BTC`** *(altruistic)* | `-0.37 / -0.40 BTC` | `+1.3245 BTC` |
| `200 sat/vB` | `+0.4060 / +0.3940 / +0.9940` | **`-1.4540 BTC`** *(altruistic)* | `-0.89 / -0.40 BTC` | `+0.9480 BTC` |
| `500 sat/vB` | `+0.1150 / +0.3850 / +0.9850` | **`-1.4600 BTC`** *(altruistic)* | `-1.93 / -0.41 BTC` | **`+0.1950 BTC`** |

- **Quantified Operator Bond & Capital**: `OperatorBond_ZNN >= 31,500 ZNN`/op (weekly Governance cadence) + `500 ZNN` forfeitable `SlotBondZnn`, `37.0 BTC` steady-state BTC bonds (`74.0 BTC` peak `8–28`-day overlap), `1.46 BTC`/lane altruistic watcher liquidity (`14.60 BTC` all 10 lanes).
- **Retail `< 1.0 BTC` Routing**: Peg-free PTLC/LN gateways ([`spec/03 §5`](./03-settlement-minted-zbtc-and-feeless-rails.md#L165-L182)).

- **Tier 1B (Portal V2 Class R)**: Separate binding + expiring/non-fungible `AssetID`; `deposit_key_point = frost_epoch_key + H_{"zBTC/PortalDepositKey/v1"}(frost_epoch_key || deposit_id)*G`; key path `MuSig2([deposit_key_point, pk_u])`; Leaf 1 Schnorr adaptor; Leaf 2 unconditional CLTV depositor exit.
- **Tier 2 (Research Target — M-12)**: Future batched / UTXO-set Bitcoin covenant once soft-fork opcodes activate (non-normative).

---

## 5. Permanent Failure & Wind-Down Plan (All 11 Items)

1. **Impairment Triggers**: Confirmed unauthorized vault spend (SMT-verified raw sweep on `ACTIVE`/`RELEASED`/`QUARANTINED` OR expired `PENDING_TRAP` via `0x0F`), `> K` reorg orphaning admitted event, `SubmitInvalidCertProof` / `SubmitEquivocationProof` firing, sustained fee `> 500 sat/vB` for `> 72` blocks or sustained slow Bitcoin blocks `> 1.476x` nominal (`R6-L8`) or Reserve `< 7 days` burn, missed generation rotation past `T_kickoff_cutoff + 60h`, or `100%` of operators offline `> 144` blocks.
2. **Pause Scope & Prohibitions**: Freeze dispatch (`RelayClaim`) + stop `RolloverTx` signing; keep `SubmitInput`, `SubmitBatch`, `Challenge*`, `FinalizeBatch`, and `RequestPegOut` OPEN. Never fabricate `RELEASED`/`REFUNDED`, reset replay, or add custodial sweep keys.
3. **Reproducible Incident Snapshot (U-14)**: `H_pause`, `StateRoot`, `B/R/P`, `PENDING PegOutRecords`, `VaultUtxoSet` (incl. `PENDING_TRAP`, `QUARANTINED`, `ORPHANED`), `ProcessedClaim`, `ProcessedForeignEvent`, destination replay keys, BTC tip, Reserve balance.
4. **Recovery & Explicit Exclusions (C-07)**: Zero custodial sweep leaf. Surviving operators continue redeeming vaults graphed into reachable fresh rounds (`G-21`). Vaults whose operators permanently lose keys or miss rotation before `T_kill_expiry` enter Wind-Down Allocation (#8).
5. **Component Loss**: Loss of `>= 1` `Q_graph` member stops new rollovers, rotations, and recovery re-graphing; existing vaults remain redeemable through reachable active rounds prior to `T_kickoff_cutoff`. Executor loss recovered permissionlessly.
6. **`PENDING` & Supply Treatment**: Resolve strictly via `FOREIGN_RELEASE` or `FOREIGN_NON_DELIVERY`; `RequestPegOut` stays open during `DRAINING`.
7. **Redemption Priority & M0**: FIFO while healthy; immediate **M0** downgrade on any trigger.
8. **Shortfall Allocation**: Voluntary audited Wind-Down Claim Contract distributing verified remaining reserves (and Governance-released `ORPHANED` vaults) pro-rata; zero silent socialization.
9. **Public Reporting**: Machine-readable Proof-of-Reserves within `6h` of pause and every `24h`.
10. **Retirement**: Complete ONLY when `P == 0`, `R == 0`, `B == 0`, and all replay sets permanently retained.
11. **Stage 0C Signet Drills (`G-1`, `G-2`, `G-22`, `G-23`)**: Publish Signet txids, 1p1c package-relay logs, & measured weights (incl. Leaf-3B SHA-256 script size `<= 380 kWU`, peak stack `<= 1,000`, and GPU prover time `<= 15 min`) for 2-in rollover, `RoundKickoffTx`, `RoundRetireTx`, staggered `StaleConnB/CKillTx` (`56d`) & `StaleChainBurnTx` (`58d`), `Take1Tx`+CPFP, `ChallengeTx`→`AssertCertDATx`+`AssertChunk`→`Take2Tx`+CPFP (BOTH 1-cert zero-handoff-slot AND 2-cert — `R6-M1`), `DisproveTx` (incl. Leaf-3B SHA-256), `BurnBond*Tx`, `WrongDepositDisproveTx^{T1,T2}`, and MUST-fail vectors (standalone connector/trap spend, Take2 substitution, spend proof omitting inclusion proof on registered Take ⇒ rejected/no halt, rotated gen-`g+1` Take ⇒ `PENDING_TRAP`, kickoff past `T_kill_expiry`, **forward-hashed digit on an honest Leaf-3B block ⇒ rejected (`R6-H2`)**, double-claim, wrong-epoch reimbursement claim).

# Part 2: Bitcoin Authorization Domain (`d_btc_asset`) & Adversarially-Bounded SPV Verifier

**Document Class:** Normative Chain Specialization (`v2.5.0-rfc`, subject to Upstream Amendments `A-SPEC-1`, `A-SPEC-2`, `A-SPEC-6`, `A-BTC-1` in [`SPEC.md §6`](../SPEC.md#L110-L122))  
**Target Domain:** `d_btc_asset` (`domainClass = AUTHORIZATION`, `purpose = ASSET`)  
**Shared Implementation Mandate:** Deterministic, panic-free Go package `vm/embedded/btcspv/` executed identically by `zenon-executor` and `SettlementContract` fraud adjudication (`OPTIMISTIC_BTC_SPV_V1`).  
**Numeric Oracle:** [`scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py`](../scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py).

---

## 1. Domain Registration, `ChainBinding` & Parameters

> **Upstream Activation Blocker (`A-SPEC-1` / `A-SPEC-6`):** Requires Phase-2 ratification activating `inputSource = L1_RELAYED`, `input_kind` `6`/`7`, and reconciling `domainClass = AUTHORIZATION` & `finalityModel = CHALLENGE_WINDOW` / `PROOF_VERIFIED`.

```text
DomainRecord {
    domainId        = <assigned u32>
    domainClass     = AUTHORIZATION     // enum ordinal 1 (A-SPEC-6)
    runtimeKind     = BTC_SPV_V2        // panic-free deterministic Go plugin
    stfSpecHash     = SHA3-256(canonical(runtimeKind || chainBinding || claimPolicy || decimalsPolicy || profileConfig))
    inputSource     = L1_RELAYED        // enum ordinal 1 (A-SPEC-1)
    execProfile     = OPTIMISTIC        // enum ordinal 1
    foreignProfile  = LIGHT_CLIENT      // enum ordinal 2
    proposerPolicy  = RANDOM_BACKUP     // upstream enum (0=SINGLE, 1=RANDOM_BACKUP, 2=STAKE_WEIGHTED)
    finalityModel   = CHALLENGE_WINDOW  // enum ordinal 1
    status          = PAUSED            // 0=ACTIVE, 1=PAUSED (Shadow Mode: SubmitInput/SubmitBatch/Challenge/FinalizeBatch OPEN)
}

ChainBinding {
    foreignChainId      : ChainId    // u16(0x0001) || bytes30(SHA3-256("BTC_MAINNET_V1" || btcGenesisHashBE)[0:30])
    chainVerifierId     : bytes32    // SHA3-256("BTC_SPV_VERIFIER_V2.4" || reproducibleBuildDigest)
    genesisAnchor       : Bytes      // BitcoinAnchor { blockHashBE, height, header(80B), cumWork, retargetStartHash, retargetStartTime, retargetHeight, mtpWindow[11] }
    releaseAdapterRef   : Bytes      // { CommitteeIdentityKey(32B), qGraphXOnly(32B), committeeSizeN(u16>=7), vaultTweakTag("zBTC/VaultTweak/v1"), recoveryTweakTag("zBTC/RecoveryTweak/v1"), provisionalTimeoutBlocks(u16=144), bucketDenoms(List<u64>), vkBitvmHash(32B), fixedReserveFeeSats(u64), minOperatorFeeSats(u64), maxPegOutFeeSats(u64) }
    enforcementSpecHash : bytes32    // SHA3-256(activated BTC-ENFORCEMENT-V1 bytes); MUST be non-zero
    finalityParams      : Bytes      // BitcoinFinalityParams below
}
```

### 1.1 `BitcoinFinalityParams` (Asserted in `scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py`)

```text
BitcoinFinalityParams :=
    confirmationDepthK       : u32   // Pilot: 14; K >= max(12, ceil(2 * AggregateInFlightMint_BTC / S(h))). Passes pre-2028 (12) & post-2028 (13). Pre-2032: Governance MUST migrate to K>=26 OR lower cap <= 5 BTC (K>=13<=14)
    minimumPostAnchorWork    : u256

    maximumProofBytes        : u32   // 15,600 B (ABI <= 16,384 B)
    executionChallengeWindow : u64   // 172,800s (48h) + T_session 43,200s (12h) = 60h -> Poisson(360 * 1.10 [ASSUMED]) = 472 BTC blocks
    releaseTimeoutUnit       : u8    // 0 = DEST_HEIGHT
    minTimeoutAboveFinalTip  : u32   // 640 blocks
    maxTimeoutAboveFinalTip  : u32   // 2,512 blocks
    releaseSubmissionGrace   : u32   // 558 blocks (K(14) + 472 + 72 ≈ 93h)

```

---

## 4. Deterministic, Panic-Free `BitcoinChainVerifier` (`vm/embedded/btcspv`)

### 4.1 Header Validation, Never-Pruned Merkle+Time Index & Reorg/Prune Rules

- **Idempotent Duplicate No-Op**: Re-submitting an already-present valid input returns `stepError = 2` (refundable up to a global cap of `<= 16` duplicate refunds per batch). Malformed/invalid inputs set `stepError = 1`.
- **`BTC_HEADER_BATCH` (`0x00`)**: Exact Bitcoin mainnet `SetCompact`, 2016-block `[302400, 4838400]`s retarget, embedded `mtpWindow[11]`, `futureTimeGuardSecs = 7,200`, `LOWEST_BLOCK_HASH_BE`, incremental reorg. Writes **`ActiveChainByHeight[height] = blockHashBE(32B) || merkleRootLE(32B) || blockTime(u32BE, 4B)` (68 B)** — **NEVER PRUNED**.
- **`BTC_REORG_STEP` (`0x01`)**: Walks 1 step/input (`<= 5` keys), updates `ActiveChainByHeight[h]`, sets `Halted = 1` on any orphaned `AdmittedEventBlocks[h]` or `ReorgSteps > 144`.
- **`BTC_PRUNE_STEP` (`0x02`)**: Rejects while `ReorgActive == 1`; deletes ONLY stale `HeaderNode`s at `height < BestTipHeight - 144 && height % 2016 != 0`.

### 4.2 Streaming SHA-256 Transaction Verifier (`BTC_TX_STREAM_CHUNK`, `0x04`)

Starts strictly from standard SHA-256 IV, enforces ordered 64 B-aligned chunks (`<= 8,192 B`), rejects SegWit marker `0x00 0x01`, verifies `totalBytes != 64` and zero trailing bytes, latches `txidLE`, `isCoinbase`, `matchedOutpoint`, and `opReturnBurnMatched` into `TxStreamState` (`175 B`). Small coinbases `<= 1,024 B` MAY pass inline (`mode = 0`) OR streamed (`mode = 1`).

### 4.3 Hardened Transaction & Claim Verification Rules (`R6-M2..M5`, `R6-L2`, `R6-L5`, `R6-L6`)

Every proof checks `ActiveChainByHeight[blockHeight]`, `BestTipHeight >= blockHeight + K - 1`, `len != 64`, `txIndex != 0`, valid coinbase, CVE-2012-2459, and `len(txBranch) == len(coinbaseBranch)`.

1. **`PEGOUT_CREATED` (`0x03`, `kind=7`)**: Writes `PegOutState[outboxId]` (`190 B`, `slotOperatorId = 0`, `lastLapsedOperatorId = 0`).
2. **`PEGOUT_SLOT_CLAIMED` (`0x0A`, `kind=7` — Single Authority & Anti-Censorship, Closing `R6-M4` & `R6-M5`)**: If `po.SlotOperatorId != 0 && (ChainMeta.BestTipHeight < po.SlotExpiryBtcHeight || inputMomentumTs < po.SlotExpiryBtcTs)`, **IGNORE (`stepError = 2`)** — NEVER overwrite an unexpired slot! If an old slot HAS expired (`BestTipHeight >= po.SlotExpiryBtcHeight && inputMomentumTs >= po.SlotExpiryBtcTs`), records `po.LastLapsedOperatorId = po.SlotOperatorId` and rejects consecutive re-claim (`newOpId == po.LastLapsedOperatorId` when another eligible op exists). Otherwise writes `po.SlotOperatorId = newOpId`, `po.SlotExpiryBtcHeight = ChainMeta.BestTipHeight + 24`, `po.SlotExpiryBtcTs = slotClaimZenonTs + 14_400`.
3. **`OPERATOR_ROUND_REGISTERED` (`0x0B` — Exact Epoch Alignment, Closing `R6-L6`)**: Requires `epoch := epoch(roundId) < 4096`, **`anchorExpiryTs == finalityEpochStartTs(epoch) + 58 days`** (exact equality!), and `anchorCutoffTs == anchorExpiryTs - 12 days`; verifies 64 B `CommitteeIdentityKey` sig over `(cfg.ChainBindingHash || opId || roundId || bondOutpoint || anchorCutoffTs || anchorExpiryTs)`; writes `OperatorBondRecord` (`52 B`).
4. **`GOVERNANCE_ADD_BINDING` (`0x0E`, `kind=7`, Governance-only)**: Writes `RecognizedBindings[chainBindingHash] = 1`.
5. **`BTC_LOCK_PROOF` (`0x05`) → `FOREIGN_LOCK`**: Proves `DepositTx` + mandatory 2-input `RolloverTx`, BIP-68/112 Leaf A, `Q_vault_d` from `releaseAdapterRef.qGraphXOnly`, `epochId < 4096`, BOTH replay keys absent, and 64 B `CommitteeIdentityKey` sig over `(cfg.ChainBindingHash || rolloverOutpoint || eligibleBitmask || epochId || takeTxidsSmtRoot || takeTxidsBlobHash)` (where `takeTxidsBlobHash` commits to the published sorted Take-txid leaf list — `R6-L5`). Writes multi-epoch `TrackedVaultRecord{ACTIVE, 0, activeEpochs=[{epochId, takeTxidsSmtRoot}]}` (`78 B`), `AdmittedEventBlocks[h_rol]`, and emits `FOREIGN_LOCK`.
6. **`BTC_RELEASE_PROOF` (`0x06` — Decoupled From Vault Status, Closing `R6-M3`)**: Loads `po := PegOutState[outboxId]` and `tv := TrackedVaultRecord[po.AssignedVaultOutpoint]`. **NEVER rejects a valid fronting proof merely because `tv.status` transitioned to `PENDING_TRAP` or `RECOVERED`!** Verifies `RecognizedBindings[po.ChainBindingHash] == 1`, `ResolutionSeenByOutboxId[outboxId]` absent, `FrontingOutpointUsed` absent, `h_front < po.TimeoutHeight`, `BestTipHeight <= po.TimeoutHeight + ReleaseSubmissionGrace + K`, exact payment + `"ZBTC_FNT"` tag, and domain-authoritative slot exclusivity (`h_front < po.SlotExpiryBtcHeight || ActiveChainByHeight[h_front].blockTime <= po.SlotExpiryBtcTs ⇒ operatorId == po.SlotOperatorId`). Transitions `tv.status = RELEASED` **iff** `tv.status == ACTIVE` (preserving `PENDING_TRAP`/`RECOVERED` so Settlement re-points `PegOutRecord` cleanly!), marks `ResolutionSeenByOutboxId[outboxId]`, and emits `FOREIGN_RELEASE(operatorId)`.
7. **`BTC_NON_DELIVERY_PROOF` (`0x07`) → `FOREIGN_NON_DELIVERY`**: Requires `ResolutionSeenByOutboxId[outboxId]` absent, `checkpointH = po.TimeoutHeight + 558`, `BestTipHeight >= checkpointH + K - 1`, emits `FOREIGN_NON_DELIVERY`.
8. **`BTC_VAULT_SPEND_PROOF` (`0x08` — Verifier-Decided SMT Inclusion vs All-Epoch Absence Across ALL Live Statuses, Closing `R5-M1` & `R6-L5`)**:
   - Proves finalized streamed tx `spendTxid` spent `vaultOutpoint` (`h_spend`) while `tv := TrackedVaultRecord[vaultOutpoint]` has `tv.status ∈ {ACTIVE, RELEASED, QUARANTINED}`:
     - **If `tv.status == QUARANTINED`**: ZERO valid spends exist prior to re-graphing (`0x0D`) ⇒ **immediate `ChainMeta.Halted = 1`**!
     - **If `tv.status ∈ {ACTIVE, RELEASED}` — Branch A (Registered Take)**: Valid `proof-format.md` V1 SMT **INCLUSION** proof that `SHA3-256(spendTxid)` is present in `e.takeTxidsSmtRoot` for ANY active epoch `e ∈ tv.activeEpochs`: if `tv.status == ACTIVE` → transitions `tv.status = PENDING_TRAP`, `tv.pendingTrapSpendHeight = h_spend` (NO halt!); if `tv.status == RELEASED` → valid reimbursement (no-op) if `spendTxid` belongs to `ReimbursementOperator`, else `PENDING_TRAP`!
     - **Branch B (Raw Unauthorized Sweep on `ACTIVE` OR `RELEASED` → Immediate `Halted = 1`)**: Proof **MUST supply valid `proof-format.md` V1 SMT ABSENCE proofs (`VerifyAbsenceByPath`) proving `SHA3-256(spendTxid)` is ABSENT from `e.takeTxidsSmtRoot` for EVERY active epoch `e ∈ tv.activeEpochs`** (constructible by anyone from the published `takeTxidsBlobHash` leaf DA!) → sets `ChainMeta.Halted = 1`!
     - **Branch C (Invalid/Omitted Proof)**: If NEITHER Branch A NOR Branch B validates, **REJECT (`stepError = 1`)**!
9. **`BTC_TRAP_TIMEOUT_HALT` (`0x0F`)**: If `tv.status == PENDING_TRAP && BestTipHeight >= tv.pendingTrapSpendHeight + 230` → sets `ChainMeta.Halted = 1`.
10. **`BTC_OPERATOR_SLASH_PROOF` (`0x09`)**: Verifies streamed tx spent `OperatorBondOutpoints[opId || roundId]` with `opReturnBurnMatched == 1` → sets `OperatorSlashed[opId] = 1`.
11. **`BTC_VAULT_RECOVERY_PROOF` (`0x0C`)**: Verifies streamed `WrongDepositDisproveTx^{T1|T2}` spent `OperatorBondOutpoints[opId || roundId]` (`opReturnBurnMatched == 1`) AND created `Out 0 = recoveryOutpoint` paying `99,899,000` sats to `Q_rec_d` while `tv.status ∈ {ACTIVE, PENDING_TRAP}` → sets `OperatorSlashed[opId] = 1`, `tv.status = RECOVERED`, inserts `TrackedVaultRecord[recoveryOutpoint] = {QUARANTINED, 0, activeEpochs=[]}`, and stores **`RecoveredVaultMap[oldOutpoint] = {recoveryOutpoint, offendingOperatorId: opId, offendingRoundId: roundId}` (`44 B`)**!
12. **`VAULT_GRAPH_EPOCH_ADDED` (`0x0D` — Strict Multi-Gen Update for `ACTIVE`, `QUARANTINED`, AND `RELEASED`, Closing `R6-M2` & `R6-L2`)**: Verifies `epochId (u16) < 4096`, `newBitmask != 0`, and 64 B `CommitteeIdentityKey` sig over `(cfg.ChainBindingHash || vaultOutpoint || newBitmask || u16BE(epochId) || newTakeTxidsSmtRoot || takeTxidsBlobHash)` while `tv.status ∈ {ACTIVE, QUARANTINED, RELEASED}`! First prunes any expired epoch `e'` whose `finalityEpochStartTs(e') + 58d < ChainMeta.BestTipBlockTime`. **STRICTLY REJECTS (`stepError = 1`) if `epochId` is ALREADY present in `tv.activeEpochs` (zero overwriting!) OR if `len(tv.activeEpochs) >= 2` (hard 2-epoch cap!)**. Appends `{epochId, newTakeTxidsSmtRoot}`, transitions `QUARANTINED → ACTIVE` (leaving `ACTIVE`/`RELEASED` unchanged), and writes `RegraphedVaultEpoch[vaultOutpoint || u16BE(epochId)]` (`0x10`)!
13. **`BTC_ROUND_RETIRED` (`0x10`)**: Proves finalized streamed `RoundRetireTx_{m,l,r}` (or `RoundRetireTx_{m,l,init}`) spent `OperatorBondOutpoints[opId || roundId]` (or `GenesisBond`) paying `3.6990 BTC` to `<pk_m>` (no `OP_RETURN` burn) → sets **`LaneRetired[opId || u16BE(epochId) || laneIndex] = 1`** (`0x11`).

---

## 5. Verifier State Layout (Domain L2 SMT — Field-Derived Sizes)

| Prefix | Key | Value (Field-Derived in Oracle) | Pruning Policy |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x01` | singleton | `ChainMeta` (`238 B`) | Never pruned |
| `0x02` | `blockHashBE(32B)` | `HeaderNode` (`160 B`) | Pruned when `height < BestTip - 144 && height % 2016 != 0 && ReorgActive == 0` |
| `0x03` | `u64BE(height)` | `blockHashBE(32B) \|\| merkleRootLE(32B) \|\| blockTime(4B)` (`68 B`) | **NEVER PRUNED** |
| `0x04` | `BitcoinOutpointID(32B)` | `u64BE(rolloverHeight)` | Never pruned |
| `0x05` | `outboxId(32B)` | `ResolutionRecord` (`37 B`) | Never pruned |
| `0x06` | `u64BE(height)` | `admittedBlockHashBE(32B)` | Never pruned |
| `0x07` | `outboxId(32B)` | `PegOutState` (`190 B`, incl. `lastLapsedOperatorId` — **R6-M5**) | Never pruned |
| `0x08` | `vaultOutpoint(36B)` | `TrackedVaultRecord` (`78 B`: status, `pendingTrapSpendHeight`, up to 2 `{epochId, takeTxidsSmtRoot}`) | Never pruned |
| `0x09` | `frontingTxidBE \|\| vout` | `u8(1)` | Never pruned |
| `0x0A` | `depositOutpoint(36B)` | `u8(1)` (`ProcessedProvisionalDeposit`) | Never pruned |
| `0x0B` | `streamId(32B)` | `TxStreamState` (`175 B`) | Prunable after `144` blocks once consumed |
| `0x0C` | `u32BE(operatorId)` | `u8(1)` (`OperatorSlashed`) | Never pruned |
| `0x0D` | `u32BE(opId) \|\| u32BE(roundId)` | `OperatorBondRecord` (`52 B`: `bondOutpoint(36) \|\| anchorCutoffTs(8) \|\| anchorExpiryTs(8)`) | Never pruned |
| `0x0E` | `chainBindingHash(32B)` | `u8(1)` (`RecognizedBindings`, Governance-only) | Never pruned |
| `0x0F` | `oldOutpoint(36B)` | `RecoveredVaultRecord` (`44 B`: `recoveryOutpoint(36) \|\| opId(4) \|\| roundId(4)`) | Never pruned |
| `0x10` | `vaultOutpoint(36B) \|\| u16BE(epochId)` | `RegraphedVaultEpoch` (`40 B`: `bitmask(8) \|\| takeTxidsSmtRoot(32)`) | Never pruned |
| `0x11` | `u32BE(opId) \|\| u16BE(epochId) \|\| u8(lane)` | `u8(1)` (`LaneRetired` — **R5-M2**) | Never pruned |

---

## 6. Mandatory SPV Conformance Test Vectors (29 Vectors)

Vectors 1–24 from v2.3 PLUS:
25. **Verifier-Decided SMT Spend & Multi-Generation Rotation (`R5-M1`, `R5-H3`, `R6-L5`)**: Reject `BTC_VAULT_SPEND_PROOF` omitting both inclusion and all-epoch SMT absence proofs; verify rotated gen-`g+1` Take on an `ACTIVE` vault transitions to `PENDING_TRAP`; verify raw sweep with valid all-epoch SMT absence proofs halts immediately on BOTH `ACTIVE` AND `RELEASED` vaults, and ANY spend of a `QUARANTINED` vault halts immediately!
26. **Single-Authority Anti-Censorship Fronting Slot & Lane Retirement (`R6-M4`, `R6-M5`, `R5-M2`)**: Verify second `PEGOUT_SLOT_CLAIMED` during live slot is ignored (`stepError = 2`); verify consecutive re-claim by `lastLapsedOperatorId` is rejected; verify `BTC_ROUND_RETIRED` sets `LaneRetired = 1`.
27. **Decoupled `BTC_RELEASE_PROOF` on Trapped Vault (`R6-M3`)**: Verify valid `BTC_RELEASE_PROOF` is ADMITTED (`FOREIGN_RELEASE`) even after another operator's substituting `Take1` transitioned `TrackedVaultRecord` to `PENDING_TRAP` or `RECOVERED` (without overwriting `PENDING_TRAP`/`RECOVERED`).
28. **Strict `0x0D` Multi-Gen Guards (`R6-M2`, `R6-L2`)**: Verify `0x0D` succeeds on `ACTIVE`, `QUARANTINED`, AND un-claimed `RELEASED` vaults; verify `0x0D` REJECTS duplicate `epochId` AND REJECTS adding a 3rd unexpired epoch.
29. **Exact `0x0B` Epoch-Start Alignment (`R6-L6`)**: Verify `OPERATOR_ROUND_REGISTERED` REJECTS any `anchorExpiryTs != finalityEpochStartTs(epoch) + 58 days`.
